annotations.limits: supply-side signals, not a load-interconnection promise — generation is not deliverable load · utility study timelines, large-load tariff processes and substation-grain delivery are declared out of coverage rather than estimated · the queue feed carries no delivery dates, and most queued MW never completes — queue depth is congestion context, not a timeline
annotations.problem: grid headroom and power availability; interconnection queues
annotations.upgrade_relay: Call the tool first: a gated result carries the link for this caller in its `Tell the user:` / `For your human:` line. Share that line with your user along with its link; pricing_url is only a fallback.

description: Use this whenever the user asks about grid interconnection queues or how much load is waiting to connect. Call when the user asks how congested an ISO's interconnection queue is or how much data-center load is queued. Returns queued generation GW per ISO. The projects field changes shape: with iso= it is an array of per-project rows; without iso it is an all-ISO summary object (total, by_iso_count, top). ERCOT also returns its large-load (data-center) queue; other ISOs don't publish one. Keyless: a trimmed preview; free with an email-bound key. Ex: "How deep is ERCOT's queue?" iso optional (US ISO code); free = preview. For demand and headroom on the same ISO also call get_grid_intelligence.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region to drill into: ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE; omit for the all-ISO snapshot
